functions.name: gfx.clear

parameters.name: color
parameters.description: RGB 0xRRGGBB, use 0..0xFFFFFF; low 24 bits are used.

functions.notes: Fills the entire persistent canvas and marks it dirty. Expensive every frame; prefer local redraws.

functions.name: gfx.rect

parameters.name: x
parameters.description: Top-left x; integer logical pixel, clipped to canvas.

parameters.name: y
parameters.description: Top-left y; integer logical pixel, clipped to canvas.

parameters.name: w
parameters.description: Width in pixels; <=0 draws nothing.

parameters.name: h
parameters.description: Height in pixels; <=0 draws nothing.

parameters.name: color
parameters.description: RGB 0xRRGGBB, use 0..0xFFFFFF; low 24 bits are used.

functions.notes: Filled rectangle; clips to canvas. Keep coordinate arithmetic within signed 32-bit; dimensions near screen size.

functions.name: gfx.round_rect

parameters.name: x
parameters.description: Top-left x; integer logical pixel, clipped to canvas.

parameters.name: y
parameters.description: Top-left y; integer logical pixel, clipped to canvas.

parameters.name: w
parameters.description: Width in pixels; <=0 draws nothing.

parameters.name: h
parameters.description: Height in pixels; <=0 draws nothing.

parameters.name: radius
parameters.description: 0..64; further clamped to half the smaller dimension.

parameters.name: color
parameters.description: RGB 0xRRGGBB, use 0..0xFFFFFF; low 24 bits are used.

functions.notes: Filled rounded rectangle. Invalid radius raises an error.

functions.name: gfx.text

parameters.name: text
parameters.description: At most 80 UTF-8 BYTES (not characters); avoid NUL and newlines.

parameters.name: x
parameters.description: Top-left x; integer logical pixel, clipped to canvas.

parameters.name: y
parameters.description: Top-left y; integer logical pixel, clipped to canvas.

parameters.name: color
parameters.description: RGB 0xRRGGBB, use 0..0xFFFFFF; low 24 bits are used.

functions.notes: Fixed 5x7 glyphs drawn at 2x, 12px advance and 14px height. Only ASCII letters/digits/space; lowercase becomes uppercase; other glyphs show a question mark. No wrapping, scaling parameter, font loading or newline layout.

functions.name: gfx.text_utf8

parameters.name: text
parameters.description: At most 192 UTF-8 BYTES (not characters); avoid NUL and newlines.

parameters.name: x
parameters.description: Top-left x; integer logical pixel, clipped to canvas.

parameters.name: y
parameters.description: Top-left y; integer logical pixel, clipped to canvas.

parameters.name: color
parameters.description: RGB 0xRRGGBB, use 0..0xFFFFFF; low 24 bits are used.

functions.notes: Existing 16px bitmap font. No wrapping, scaling parameter, font loading or newline layout. UTF-8 decoding does not imply all-language font coverage; missing compiled glyphs are skipped with spacing.

parameters.name: text
parameters.description: At most 192 UTF-8 bytes.

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: Exactly 16, 24 or 48.

functions.notes: Returns the width using matching built-in UTF-8 font advances; not the fixed gfx.text font. Use it to wrap/truncate in Lua.

functions.name: gfx.blit

parameters.name: handle
parameters.description: Opaque live handle returned by asset.image or asset.sound; never invent a number.

parameters.name: x
parameters.description: Top-left x; integer logical pixel, clipped to canvas.

parameters.name: y
parameters.description: Top-left y; integer logical pixel, clipped to canvas.

functions.notes: Draws frame ZERO of an image at native frame dimensions, not necessarily the full sprite sheet; clips; uses alpha if packed. Wrong handle/error raises.

functions.name: gfx.blit_clean

parameters.name: handle
parameters.description: Opaque live handle returned by asset.image or asset.sound; never invent a number.

parameters.name: x
parameters.description: Top-left x; integer logical pixel, clipped to canvas.

parameters.name: y
parameters.description: Top-left y; integer logical pixel, clipped to canvas.

functions.notes: Same frame-zero drawing but does NOT invalidate. Call gfx.invalidate for the affected region before presentation. Advanced batching only.

functions.name: gfx.blit_frame

parameters.name: handle
parameters.description: Opaque live handle returned by asset.image or asset.sound; never invent a number.

parameters.name: frame
parameters.description: Zero-based 0..frameCount-1, also <=65535; row-major across sheet.

parameters.name: x
parameters.description: Top-left x; integer logical pixel, clipped to canvas.

parameters.name: y
parameters.description: Top-left y; integer logical pixel, clipped to canvas.

functions.notes: Uses packed frameWidth/frameHeight. No runtime resizing/rotation. Invalid frame raises.

functions.name: gfx.invalidate

parameters.name: x
parameters.description: Top-left x; integer logical pixel, clipped to canvas.

parameters.name: y
parameters.description: Top-left y; integer logical pixel, clipped to canvas.

parameters.name: w
parameters.description: Width in pixels; <=0 draws nothing.

parameters.name: h
parameters.description: Height in pixels; <=0 draws nothing.

functions.notes: Marks modified canvas region for next normal presentation; drawing is not performed. Dirty regions may merge or fall back to full canvas.

functions.name: gfx.hold_present

parameters.name: hold
parameters.description: true to suppress normal end-of-update presentation; false to resume.

functions.notes: Lua updates and drawing continue while held; remember to release. This is not sleep, threading or a pause API.

functions.name: gfx.restore

parameters.name: handle
parameters.description: Opaque live handle returned by asset.image or asset.sound; never invent a number.

parameters.name: x
parameters.description: Top-left x; integer logical pixel, clipped to canvas.

parameters.name: y
parameters.description: Top-left y; integer logical pixel, clipped to canvas.

parameters.name: w
parameters.description: Positive width; zero/negative raises.

parameters.name: h
parameters.description: Positive height; zero/negative raises.

functions.notes: Copies the same x/y region from a full opaque RGB565 background image, not a sprite placed at x/y. Positive w/h required; clips to image/canvas. Other formats raise.

functions.name: data.size

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Game-relative UTF-8 path 1..32 bytes; no leading slash, backslash, controls, empty/./.. segments. Read-only under /Games/<id>/. SDK uses stricter portable ASCII.

functions.notes: File length in bytes; nil on absent/unreadable/directory/unsafe path. No file handle returned.

functions.name: data.read

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Game-relative UTF-8 path 1..32 bytes; no leading slash, backslash, controls, empty/./.. segments. Read-only under /Games/<id>/. SDK uses stricter portable ASCII.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Zero-based nonnegative byte offset; representable on device (signed int32).

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: 0..512; offset+count must be <= file size.

functions.notes: Binary-safe exact string; missing/unsafe path => nil; out-of-range/seek/read failure raises. Not an unbounded file reader; avoid reading entire assets into Lua.

functions.name: asset.image

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: 1..23 ASCII characters [a-z0-9_-], matching an entry in the manifest assets BVP1.

functions.notes: Loads/checks image payload and returns opaque handle; missing/wrong type/cache/CRC failure raises. Images are reference-counted; sounds pinned until exit. Cache shared: 32 slots / 1.5MiB; sound subset <=512KiB.

functions.name: asset.sound

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: 1..23 ASCII characters [a-z0-9_-], matching an entry in the manifest assets BVP1.

functions.notes: Loads/checks sound payload and returns opaque handle; missing/wrong type/cache/CRC failure raises. Images are reference-counted; sounds pinned until exit. Cache shared: 32 slots / 1.5MiB; sound subset <=512KiB.

functions.name: asset.release

parameters.name: handle
parameters.description: Opaque live handle returned by asset.image or asset.sound; never invent a number.

functions.notes: False for invalid/stale handle. Images decrement refs/free on last release. Sounds return true but remain pinned until game exit to protect mixer memory. Do not retain/reuse a released image handle.

functions.name: asset.info

parameters.name: handle
parameters.description: Opaque live handle returned by asset.image or asset.sound; never invent a number.

functions.notes: Image handles ONLY: returns full image width, height, frame width, frame height (in that order); sound handle raises.
functions.example: local w, h, fw, fh = asset.info(image)

functions.name: audio.play

parameters.name: handle
parameters.description: Opaque live handle returned by asset.image or asset.sound; never invent a number.

parameters.name: volume
parameters.description: Optional 0..100, default 100; relative gain also follows system volume.

functions.notes: One-shot. Sound handle required; false if mixer unavailable/paused/unhealthy. Four voices; full mixer steals oldest non-loop voice, or slot zero if every voice loops. No individual voice ID/status. Pack containing sounds starts mixer at game load. No MP3 decoding API.

functions.name: audio.loop

parameters.name: handle
parameters.description: Opaque live handle returned by asset.image or asset.sound; never invent a number.

parameters.name: volume
parameters.description: Optional 0..100, default 100; relative gain also follows system volume.

functions.notes: Loop. Sound handle required; false if mixer unavailable/paused/unhealthy. Four voices; full mixer steals oldest non-loop voice, or slot zero if every voice loops. No individual voice ID/status. Pack containing sounds starts mixer at game load. No MP3 decoding API.

functions.name: audio.play_file

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Exactly game-relative audio/<name>.wav; lowercase prefix/suffix, 11..32 bytes and safe relative path.

parameters.name: volume
parameters.description: Optional 0..100, default 100.

functions.notes: Returns true when QUEUED, not when playback succeeds. One pending path (later call wins), processed after update/presentation/save. WAV <=256KiB, mono PCM8 unsigned/12kHz OR PCM16 signed LE/48kHz, <=2.5 seconds. Failure is logged [WORD_AUDIO]; prior file-backed sound replaced after successful load. Cannot stream music/MP3.

functions.name: audio.stop_all
functions.notes: Stops active mixer voices, does not free asset handles. Does not cancel a play_file request still queued earlier in the same update.

functions.name: input.direction
functions.notes: Current held digital direction or nil when neutral; no analog axes, diagonals or confirm state. Portrait is already remapped; do not rotate directions again.

functions.name: input.pressed
functions.notes: Consumes ONE queued edge per call, not a state. Queue length four; directions use newest final slot on overflow; confirm drops when full. No release events or auto-repeat for held direction. Drain with a bounded loop (max four). Startup/resume waits for neutral.

functions.name: input.serial
functions.notes: Input change counter for direction transitions and accepted confirm; not serial-port data. Changes may exceed queue entries. Reset at game start, wraps; not a high-precision timer.

functions.name: system.time_ms
functions.notes: Device uptime from millis(), includes POWER pause time; underlying uint32 wraps ~49.7 days, returned through signed 32-bit Lua integer (~24.9 day sign boundary). Use update dt for gameplay; short deltas with wrap arithmetic only. Not Unix time.

functions.name: system.day
functions.notes: 0 before valid clock (Unix timestamp <2024-01-01); otherwise floor((unixSeconds+8*3600)/86400), fixed UTC+8 day number. Not locale-aware or guaranteed available. No set/sync API.
functions.example: local day = system.day(); if day == 0 then print("No date") end

functions.name: system.exit
functions.notes: Requests clean exit handled by host after update; it does not abort the current Lua function. Return immediately. No shutdown/menu/settings APIs.

functions.name: storage.get

parameters.name: key
parameters.description: 1..24 ASCII letters/digits/_/-.

parameters.name: default
parameters.description: Fallback integer, default 0.

functions.notes: Per-project integer store, cached in memory, 16 keys total. Missing key returns default. Invalid key raises.

functions.name: storage.set

parameters.name: key
parameters.description: 1..24 ASCII letters/digits/_/-.

functions.notes: Queue/update key; 17th key raises. Writes coalesced about every 2s and on normal pause/exit; no immediate durable-success return. [GAME_SAVE] okay=0 reports failure. No key deletion. Never save every frame. ID determines /Games/<id>/save.dat; preserve on updates.

functions.name: storage.word_get

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: 2..48 lowercase ASCII letters/digits/hyphens.

functions.notes: Advanced per-project hashed progress.log store: missing =>0, values positive int32. Not cross-project shared. Allocates memory proportional to entries, up to32768; avoid for ordinary games. Log limit4MiB, no deletion API.

functions.name: storage.word_set

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: 2..48 lowercase ASCII letters/digits/hyphens.

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: 1..2147483647 (zero/negative rejected).

functions.notes: Advanced append queue: max32 distinct pending IDs per update, flushed after update/on pause/exit. Memory/write failures may terminate game. Use storage.set for small scores. No included vocabulary content.

functions.name: vocab.open

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Game-relative UTF-8 path 1..32 bytes; no leading slash, backslash, controls, empty/./.. segments. Read-only under /Games/<id>/. SDK uses stricter portable ASCII.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Optional zero-based cursor, default0; 0..9999 and <pack count.

functions.notes: RESERVED: requires attached internal BVW3 cache owned by beatvocab-study, hidden by international catalog. Do NOT use or adopt that ID in public projects; no word data/authorization supplied. init/top-level opens synchronously and returns count; during update queues open and returns nil; later tick opens/primes, failure stops script.

functions.name: vocab.state

parameters.name: index
parameters.description: Zero-based 0..count-1.

functions.notes: RESERVED: requires attached internal BVW3 cache owned by beatvocab-study, hidden by international catalog. Do NOT use or adopt that ID in public projects; no word data/authorization supplied. Returns cached packed int32 state (0 unseen). Invalid/unattached index raises.

functions.name: vocab.set

parameters.name: index
parameters.description: Zero-based 0..count-1.

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: Positive int32 encoded state.

functions.notes: RESERVED: requires attached internal BVW3 cache owned by beatvocab-study, hidden by international catalog. Do NOT use or adopt that ID in public projects; no word data/authorization supplied. Appends progress synchronously before cached update; failure raises. Learning encoding uses 1+round*8+level with round1..1000000 and level0..5.

functions.name: vocab.read

parameters.name: index
parameters.description: Zero-based 0..count-1.

functions.notes: RESERVED: requires attached internal BVW3 cache owned by beatvocab-study, hidden by international catalog. Do NOT use or adopt that ID in public projects; no word data/authorization supplied. Raw indexed record bytes in a string (bounded record buffer2048); no parsed table; read failure raises.

functions.name: vocab.info
functions.notes: RESERVED: requires attached internal BVW3 cache owned by beatvocab-study, hidden by international catalog. Do NOT use or adopt that ID in public projects; no word data/authorization supplied. Returns count, windowFirst, windowAfter(exclusive), loadedBytes, windowBytes. Unattached raises.
functions.example: -- Reserved only: local n, first, after, loaded, size = vocab.info()

functions.name: vocab.ready
functions.notes: RESERVED: requires attached internal BVW3 cache owned by beatvocab-study, hidden by international catalog. Do NOT use or adopt that ID in public projects; no word data/authorization supplied. Pack count when async selection is ready and attached, otherwise nil.

functions.name: vocab.learned

parameters.name: blockedBits
parameters.description: Empty string or binary bitmap exactly ceil(count/8) bytes; bit i%8 set excludes zero-based entry i (LSB first).

functions.notes: RESERVED: requires attached internal BVW3 cache owned by beatvocab-study, hidden by international catalog. Do NOT use or adopt that ID in public projects; no word data/authorization supplied. Count valid learned encoded states excluding bitmap entries.

functions.name: vocab.stats

parameters.name: blockedBits
parameters.description: Empty string or binary bitmap exactly ceil(count/8) bytes; bit i%8 set excludes zero-based entry i (LSB first).

parameters.name: round
parameters.description: 1..1000000, learning round, not current clock time.

functions.notes: RESERVED: requires attached internal BVW3 cache owned by beatvocab-study, hidden by international catalog. Do NOT use or adopt that ID in public projects; no word data/authorization supplied. Returns learned,due,weak,mastered,firstNew. firstNew is ONE-based or0; state/read indices are zero-based. Due<=round, weak level<=1, mastered level>=4.
functions.example: -- Reserved only: local learned, due, weak, mastered, first = vocab.stats("", 1)

functions.name: vocab.review

parameters.name: blockedBits
parameters.description: Empty string or binary bitmap exactly ceil(count/8) bytes; bit i%8 set excludes zero-based entry i (LSB first).

parameters.name: round
parameters.description: 1..1000000, learning round, not current clock time.

parameters.name: dueOnly
parameters.description: Boolean filter: only due states.

parameters.name: weakOnly
parameters.description: Boolean filter: only levels0..1.

functions.notes: RESERVED: requires attached internal BVW3 cache owned by beatvocab-study, hidden by international catalog. Do NOT use or adopt that ID in public projects; no word data/authorization supplied. Returns up to20 ONE-based entry positions in pack order, excluding blocked/unlearned/invalid states. Subtract1 before state/read.
functions.example: -- Reserved only: local positions = vocab.review("", 1, true, false)

functions.name: print

parameters.description: Up to first four values; each converted to string and truncated to80 bytes.

functions.notes: USB debug [GAME_LOG] line, not screen text. No raw UART API. Avoid per-frame spam.
